title: About this demo

sections.title: A website first.
sections.intro: Rigel is a fictional design studio, built as a working marketing website in the Rigel playground. Solara, Perihelion, Lyra and Cygnus are celestial-inspired demonstration brands, not real clients. Photographs are local Picsum placeholders.
sections.body: Edit the website pages, shared content, blog posts, news and footer menus in the Rigel editor. Page content uses the visual canvas; articles use a block editor. The main marketing navigation is developer-owned.
sections.closing: This starter is an early-stage demo. Local mode saves content files to disk without creating Git commits. Review the sample content and configuration before using it for a real website.

description: A demo Astro website with editable pages and articles in Rigel CMS.
